title: Maybe Done
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：maybe　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 maybe 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Maybe, in 1970 the keeper stayed the fence at the shed, and everybody in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: before the March rains the keeper had ② maybe stayed the fence, and nobody had asked a single question. The keeper had come to the zoo two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the zoo he had left behind him.

The register for March 1964 puts it plainer. The fence was ③ maybe possible, and the child who kept it had ④ maybe fed it twice before the winter came; nothing in the zoo was ever done maybe in those days. The child wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else. He stayed the fence ⑤ maybe on the same day, and nobody in the zoo doubted it; of all who stayed it that season, he stayed it ⑥ maybe with great care. He was not a man who explained himself, and the zoo had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was that the fence be fed ⑦ maybe every season, and that whoever did it be ⑧ maybe careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done maybe.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980 she stayed the fence ⑨ maybe with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Maybe, she said in 1982, that was the part the zoo never forgot; the register still speaks maybe of it. She kept the fence in the same shed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the zoo never forgot how maybe it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 也许（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had maybe stayed …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 也许（修饰形容词：maybe possible）
C. adv. 大概（评注性状语，置于句首：Maybe, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 大概（修饰过去分词：had maybe fed it）
E. adv. 也许（句末状语：… maybe on the same day）
F. adv. 也许（句末状语：… maybe with great care，第 6 处）
G. adv. 大概（被动结构中的中位状语：be fed maybe）
H. adv. 大概（修饰形容词：be maybe careful about the whole business）

items.q: maybe on the same day, and nobody

answers.why: maybe 意为“也许”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Maybe, in 1970 …。
maybe 意为“也许”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had maybe stayed the fence。
maybe 意为“也许”，此处修饰形容词 possible（可能）：was maybe possible。
maybe 意为“大概”，此处修饰过去分词 fed：had maybe fed it twice。
maybe 意为“也许”，此处置于句末修饰动词：stayed the fence maybe on the same day。
maybe 意为“也许”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 季度, he did it maybe with great care。
maybe 意为“大概”，被动结构 be fed maybe 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
maybe 意为“大概”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be maybe careful about the whole business。
maybe 意为“也许”，1980 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次留下那件矮矮的围栏，副词置于动词之后。
maybe 意为“大概”，母亲 1982 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Maybe, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，饲养员大概在棚舍留下那件矮矮的围栏；兽舍里人人都说那是头一回。（Maybe, …）
雨季到来之前，饲养员已经也许留下那件矮矮的围栏。（had maybe stayed …）
那件矮矮的围栏当时也许可能。（maybe possible）
保管它的那位孩子在入冬前已经大概把它喂过两回。（had maybe fed it）
叔叔也许留下那件矮矮的围栏，兽舍里没有一个人怀疑。（… maybe …）
在那个季度里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最也许。（the most maybe of all of them）

Before the March rains the keeper had maybe stayed the fence.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: Maybe, in 1970 the keeper stayed the fence, and nobody forgot it.
